QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line ~568) sets the global pointers to its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or to `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself over the pointers. It never says this is the only in-tree user of the setter, and it describes the allocator as "its own consumer", which doesn't claim uniqueness.
